subject: INLA program crashing repeatedly when running INLA tutorial

messages.author: 9ac028bf29ccd898
messages.subject: INLA program crashing repeatedly when running INLA tutorial
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to run the simple mixed effects Poisson regression model in the example from this INLA tutorial: https://codingclubuc3m.rbind.io/post/2019-11-05/

This is the code I ran, exactly as it was given in the tutorial:

m1 <- inla(Cases ~ 1 + AVGIDIST,
           data = as.data.frame(NY8),
           family = "poisson",
           E = NY8$Expected, control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
           control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE))

The data was obtained and set up exactly as described in the tutorial, before the regression model. But where the tutorial shows some output from the model, I get the error message (when running with the `verbose = T` option) attached as a text file. 

I am unable to figure out what is going wrong. The INLA installation did not produce any errors, and the test model given on the installation page ran fine without any errors. 

My session information is attached as another text file. Please let me know if any other information is needed to debug the error.

I appreciate any pointers you can give me. 

Thanks a lot!
